settings.heading: Simple, named, on the label
settings.lead: Every chew combines one live gut-flora culture with prebiotic fibre and seeds. Here’s what each ingredient is, and the full composition printed on every jar.

settings.foot_note: Bacillus velezensis is listed as a zootechnical additive (4b1820, 7.50 × 10¹¹ CFU per kg). See full composition

settings.alt: Two Shadows soft chews, one broken in half
settings.title: Bacillus velezensis
settings.text: A live gut-flora culture that helps support a balanced digestive system.

settings.alt: Inulin powder on a wooden spoon next to chicory root
settings.title: Inulin
settings.text: A prebiotic fibre from chicory root that feeds the good bacteria already in the gut.

settings.alt: Psyllium husk in a ceramic bowl
settings.title: Psyllium husk
settings.text: A gentle natural fibre for everyday digestive comfort.

settings.alt: Pumpkin seeds beside a halved squash
settings.title: Pumpkin & squash seeds
settings.text: A familiar, wholesome source of fibre and natural oils.

settings.title: A named, deposited strain
settings.text: DSM 15544 is its reference number in the German collection of microorganisms (DSMZ), so the culture can be traced and identified.

settings.title: Spore-forming by nature
settings.text: Bacillus cultures form spores, a dormant, protective state, which is why they’re widely used in shelf-stable feeds.

settings.title: Listed on every jar
settings.text: It appears in the composition as zootechnical additive 4b1820, at 7.50 × 10¹¹ CFU per kg.

settings.title: In every chew
settings.text: [X] billion live cultures per chew, guaranteed to the end of shelf life.

settings.label: Product
settings.value: Gut & Digestion soft chews. Complementary feed for dogs over 12 weeks of age.

settings.label: Composition
settings.value: Tapioca starch, gram flour, glycerine, refined rapeseed oil, yeast products, potato starch, beta glucans, inulin, sugars, psyllium husk powder, pumpkin and squash seeds, crude lecithins, vegetal carbon, minerals, vegetable derivatives.

settings.label: Analytical constituents
settings.value: Crude protein 11.5% · Crude fat 13.3% · Crude fibre 0.6% · Crude ash 3.1% · Moisture 14%.

settings.label: Made in
settings.value: The UK, in a GB-registered feed facility.
